name: ALM WebFlow Studio
purpose: Create, replay, execute, schedule, and measure governed browser automations for web applications.
usage: Replay a workflow as guided training
Execute or schedule a saved automation
Run an Excel or CSV driven batch

examples: show the steps in this automation
show me how to record a flow

ai_provider_integration.governance_boundary: External providers interpret intent; EngenieBridge remains the only governed WebFlow invocation path.
ai_provider_integration.secret_policy: Provider credentials and runtime secret values are not exposed through provider status or orchestration responses.

runtime_boundary.hosted_studio: orchestration, governance, preview, distribution, audit, scheduling
runtime_boundary.local_client: interactive recording and browser execution in the user network context
runtime_boundary.prohibited: generic proxy, VPN, tunnel, remote shell, or firewall bypass
